description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the number of datasets categorized by language over a series of years. The horizontal category axis is labeled "Year" and displays discrete chronological years from 2012 to 2021, followed by a final unlabeled category marked with a solid gray rectangle on the axis line. The vertical value axis is labeled "Number of datasets" and employs a logarithmic scale (base 10) ranging from $10^0$ to $10^2$, with major tick labels and corresponding horizontal grid lines at $10^0$, $10^1$, and $10^2$. The bars are grouped by year along the horizontal axis, with each group containing up to six bars representing different language categories as defined by an inset legend: English (blue), All other (orange), Arabic (green), Bengali (red), Spanish (purple), and Russian (brown). In the earliest years shown (2012 to 2015), only the English (blue) category is present, with values between approximately 2 and 3. As the years progress, the groups expand to include more language categories. The English (blue) bar is generally the tallest in the labeled years, reaching the highest overall value in the chart at approximately 90 datasets in 2021. The shortest bars in the chart align with the $10^0$ (1) line, which can be seen for the Bengali (red) category in 2017 and 2018, and the Russian (brown) category in the final unlabeled group. The groups are sorted chronologically from left to right. The final group of bars on the far right, positioned above the gray rectangle, is visually emphasized by being rendered in faded, lighter shades of the colors specified in the legend.
